verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents a Code Sandbox in which an agent can run Python code and shell commands in an isolated cloud environment, and skills can bundle scripts. Hosted MCPs also let developers write their own server code in a GitHub repo and deploy it as tools. However, the sandbox is a capability the agent decides when to call, not a developer-placed code step in a deterministic workflow, and nothing in the pack shows JavaScript execution. Missing for 10: a documented code node or step that a developer inserts at a fixed point in a workflow, JavaScript runtime support, details on step inputs/outputs and packages, and independent hands-on corroboration.
